title: PSA for Claude pro subscribers!
author: Moist_Signal_5080
selftext:
For those of us that got the $100 credit, Claude automatically enables “turn on usage credits” toggle. So if you hit your hourly limit, even if using Opus, it starts draining your $100 credit. I was planning on saving mine for more intense projects, and noticed it used $4 of it without me knowing.

Make sure you go into usage and toggle that off, so you don’t burn your credit on accident.
